description.value: The Comox Valley Inn & Suites is a centrally located motel in downtown Courtenay on Vancouver Island, offering a wide range of room types from single-bed units to multi-bed kitchen suites sleeping up to six, with a pet-friendly policy for dogs. The property sits within a 10-minute walk of more than eight restaurants, bistros, pubs, the Puntledge River trail, and a beer and wine store, making it a practical overnight base for cyclists touring the Comox Valley. The website notes a forthcoming redesign but the business is clearly operational.

address.value: 1190 Cliffe Avenue, Courtenay, British Columbia V9N 2K1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business is open, with matching address (1190 Cliffe Avenue, Courtenay), local phone (250-334-4476), and website URL. The website explicitly lists included amenities (free Wi-Fi, coin-op laundry, on-site restaurant for breakfast and lunch, nearby restaurants/pubs) but makes no mention of bike storage, bike rooms, e-bike charging, or any cyclist-specific facilities, so those are null rather than false.
concerns: Website banner reads 'This site is getting a refresh... please check back soon for more information!' — content may be incomplete or outdated, but the business appears open.
OSM lists only the local number (+1-250-334-4476); website also advertises a toll-free number (1-800-811-5955) not captured in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational motel in downtown Courtenay with a functioning website, confirmed address, and multiple amenities useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: On-site restaurant serves breakfasts and lunches (not dinner). No grocery store specifically named in the nearby amenities list, though Rexall Drugs and a Dollar Store are mentioned within walking distance.

Laundry.detail: Website lists 'Laundry – coin-operated washers and dryers' as an on-site facility

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states 'More than 8 restaurants,' 'Bistros and pubs,' and 'Dairy Queen' are all within a 10-minute walk

Wi-Fi.detail: Website lists 'FREE Internet access' and 'Wi-Fi' as included with every room at no extra charge

wow_evidence: free Wi-Fi, coin-op laundry, on-site restaurant for breakfast and lunch
